locations.title: Jotunn Star Wonder Weapon Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, collect two items around the map:
   - [Chilly Chunks](#loc=566620)
   - [Chain Links](#loc=566645)
- Place the Chilly Chunks on top of the [Market Table](#loc=566640) and wait until a special round.
- Kill the Zursa that spawns and it will drop the [Lantern](#loc=566642).
- Head to the [Burial Grounds Door](#loc=566648) and hold interact on it to open the door.
- Head inside and interact with the symbols on the wall in this order when looking at the center from the staircase: **Left, Right, Back, Front**
- Follow the ghost of Astrid to two locations and give her energy by killing zombies nearby.
- Once she brings you near the zipline, jump onto the rocks and climb up the lighthouse to the top.
- Once at the top, a short cutscene will play and the Jotunn Star will be on the table.

locations.title: Totenreich Main Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- First, complete the [Jotunn Star Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=940415).
- Then, grab the [Crowbar](#loc=566653) from the lighthouse.
- Around the map, there are two locations a tamper note can spawn:
  - [Tamper Note Spawn](#loc=1052757)
  - [Tamper Note Spawn](#loc=1052758)
- Read the note and remember where they transferred the Flak Gun Round to. It's possible they didn't transfer it at all.
- Head to the War Factory and read the [Cargo Manifest](#loc=566637) to learn the ID of the Cargo Crate, based on what the note said about the transfer.
- Head to each of the [Cargo Crates](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-totenreich?search=cargo_crate%20%26%26%20category%3A14087), find the correct one, and open it to receive the [Flak Gun Round](#loc=566661):
- Head to the [Cannon](#loc=566669) and place the Flak Gun Round inside, then hit it with the Jotunn Star to shoot it.
- Head back to the landing and grab the [Transmitter](#loc=566670).
- Go inside Tyr's head and place the transmitter in the wall. 
- Lights will begin blinking in Tyr's head. Note down how many each light blinks. There will be two sets of blinking.
- Head to the [Frozen Ascender](#loc=566673) and use a molotov to burn the ice and head up.
- Interact with the [Radio Panel](#loc=566674) and the set the Amplitude to the left number of the first set, then the frequency to the right number of the first set.
- Do it again with the second set of numbers, then grab the [Wunderbarrage Controller](#loc=566675).
- Use the Wunderbarrage Controller on the [Garage Door](#loc=566683) to gain acccess to the building.
- Next, you'll need to obtain three different pieces of Uranium:
  - Use an [Olaf's Cod Cranker](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-totenreich?search=olaf's_cod_cranker%20%26%26%20category%3A27996) to find and fish up a green fish, which will spawn an Irradiated Ravager. Kill it to receive the [Uranium](#loc=566676).
  - Use a Glocke Drop and kill 20 zombies while they are in the air to receive the [Uranium](#loc=566682).
  - Head to the Core Foundry and melee open the [Vent](#loc=566677). Send an ARC-XD through the vent and use it to blow up barrels to open the lab underneath the building on Fishery Island. Once inside, note the numbers next to the doors in the hallway with the radiation symbol, then convert those to letters and place the corresponding jars with the letters onto the [Jar Machine](#loc=566680). Grab the liquid and pour it onto the large arm on the table of the lab to acquire the [Necrospike](#loc=566679). Use the Necrospike to lockpick the door into the [Uranium](#loc=566681).
- Head to the [Claw Machine](#loc=566684) and place all three uranium inside.
- Interact with the Claw Machine and line up the uranium inside so that the perfect amount of energy goes through, then grab the [Atomkraft Core](#loc=566685).
- Place the Atomkraft Core on the pallets near the [Generator](#loc=566686) and defend it until it's charged.
- Place the charged Atomkraft Core to the [Barrel](#loc=566687) on the bridge then grab the [Dravakar Shard](#loc=566688) after the cutscene.
- Bring the Dravakar Shard to the [Fireplace](#loc=566689) in Blodheim Hall, place it inside, then use the Jotunn Star's secondary attack to light it.
- Use a Disciple Injection to grab zombies then throw them into the bonfire.
- Kill all the zombies during the lockdown and grab the [Sunstone](#loc=566690).
- Place the Sunstone on the [Altar](#loc=566691) inside the church then use the Jotunn Star's secondary attack on it.
- A large rune will appear in the sky with arrows. There will be floating runes around the map. Use the Jotunn Star's secondary attack on the wood under each rune in the order by how many lines are on the arrows pointing to it.
- Head into Tyr's head and interact with Tyr to begin the boss fight.

locations.title: Fish Trap Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, grab the [Fish in a Bucket](#loc=570087) on Beacon Island and acquire a Shock Charge.
- Wait until a T.E.D.D task spawns then place the fish onto the T.E.D.D task machine and throw a shock charge at it.
- Get the max tier reward from the task then pick up both pieces and bring them to the [Fish Mount](#loc=570099) to build a secret trap.

locations.title: Echoes of the Damned Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- While playing as Richtofen, get to Round 15 or any multiple of 5 past Round 15.
- With melee macchiato, punch the [Barrel](#loc=570100) in Core Foundry and dig inside of it to find the [Ritterkreuz](#loc=940446).
- Pick it up to start the cutscenes.

locations.title: Kneehigh Helm Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, acquire the Shadow Rift weapon mod on a weapon.
- Then, head around the map and shoot the four hidden Gnomes:
   - [Gnome](#loc=570085)
   - [Gnome](#loc=570086)
   - [Gnome](#loc=570097)
   - [Gnome](#loc=570095)
- After shooting all four, the [Kneehigh Helm](#loc=570098) will be inside Loven's Antiquities on the counter.

locations.title: Icebane Helm Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- In a single game, you will need to use the Flammenfalle traps to:
   - Kill 250 zombies with the trap by interacting with the lever for it to shoot out fire
   - Kill 50 ice zombies while standing inside the heat area of the trap when interacting with the trap itself
- After both are completed, the Icebane Helm will drop on the ground

locations.title: Golden Tide Helm Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, acquire [Olaf's Cod Cranker](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-totenreich?search=olaf's_cod_cranker%20%26%26%20category%3A27996) and fish at the various [Fishing Spots](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-totenreich?search=fishing_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A27995) around the map.
- Eventually, a zombie named Olaf will spawn. Killing Olaf will drop the helmet.

locations.title: Cointoss Helm Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Complete the [Free Powerup Easter Egg](#loc=940438) 10 times.
- On the tenth time, the helm will spawn instead of a powerup.

locations.title: Free Powerup Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Inside Tyr's head above the [Power Switch](#loc=566623) will be a display listing a letter and a number.
- Head to those coordinates on the map and kill 75 zombies within those coordinates. If done so, Tyr's eyes will both glow green.
- On the next round, head inside Tyr's head for a free powerup.

locations.title: Totenreich Super Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, acquire the [Jotunn Star](#loc=566651) from the [Jotunn Star Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=940415).
- Then, on top of the lighthouse's ledge, grab the [The Silent Heir Crossbow](#loc=959282) on the edge of the ledge.
- Then, head to the [Fishing Spot](#loc=570078) behind Loven's Antiquities and you'll see an iceberg in the water.
- Use the [Olaf's Cod Cranker](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-totenreich?search=olaf's_cod_cranker%20%26%26%20category%3A27996) and immediately use the Wild Fire Field Upgrade to light up the fishing rod.
- Pull the rod when it catches something to pull in the ice berg, then melt it with Wild Fire to unfreeze the [Toy Box](#loc=959289).
- Then, outside the Burial Grounds, a special zombie named King Draugvald the Undying will spawn.
- Kill the King, with the last hit being from The Silent Heir Crossbow to drop his crown.
- Pick it up and place it into the Toy Box to receive the Guardian Toy, then Exfil.
